subject: System Design
title: SQL vs NoSQL Trade-Offs
description: A quick, practical guide to SQL vs NoSQL Trade-Offs.

hook.text: SQL databases enforce strict schemas. NoSQL databases let you store anything in any shape.

buildup.text: SQL excels at complex queries, joins, and transactions. NoSQL excels at scale and flexibility.

discovery.text: SQL databases scale vertically well. NoSQL databases are designed to scale horizontally from day one.

twist.text: Modern SQL databases like CockroachDB scale horizontally. NoSQL databases like MongoDB added transactions.

climax.text: The boundary between SQL and NoSQL is blurring. Choose based on your access patterns, not hype.

punchline.text: Pick the database that fits your queries, not trends.

quiz.question: What is a key advantage of NoSQL databases?
options: Designed to scale horizontally from day one
